The paths visibly differ in flexibility and structure but converge on a polished product core. Dark near-black background with violet, cyan and emerald accents, refined dimensional geometry, premium engineering consultancy look, generous negative space. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no copyrighted user interface.
